proposals.defect: Schema is generated in serialization mode instead of validation mode, so the schema sent to the provider/validated against can drop or alter fields (e.g. fields with defaults become required or computed fields are added), diverging from the model's input contract.

Schema is generated with by_alias=False, so fields that have aliases are exposed under their Python names rather than the alias names the model requires; the provider output then fails or loses required aliased fields on reconstruction.
